Kiro's Founding Problem: Prototypes That Never Ship

Sound familiar? Great demo, dead project.
AI made prototyping trivial — but most AI-built prototypes never reach production.
No docs, no clarity on design decisions, no validated requirements.
Kiro's entire premise is fixing exactly that failure point.

Episode 9 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
